calculations.formula: 100 × (nuclear + wind + total solar) / (utility-scale total generation + estimated small-scale solar PV)

inputs.label: Nuclear generation
inputs.reason: Eligible LWR technology class; shown separately from renewables.

inputs.label: Wind generation
inputs.reason: Eligible onshore and offshore wind technology class.

inputs.label: Total solar generation
inputs.reason: Eligible PV and solar-thermal electricity, including estimated small-scale PV.

inputs.label: Estimated small-scale solar PV
inputs.reason: Added because it is outside the utility-scale total and inside total solar.

limitations: Hydropower, geothermal, and biomass are excluded from the eligible numerator until site/pathway evidence satisfies V1 rules.

EIA values may not sum exactly because of independent rounding.

calculations.formula: 100 × (eligible EIA-860 utility-scale net summer capacity + small-scale solar PV) / (all utility-scale net summer capacity + small-scale solar PV)

inputs.label: Eligible utility-scale net summer capacity
inputs.reason: Generator rows classified eligible by V1 methodology.

inputs.label: Estimated small-scale solar PV capacity
inputs.reason: Eligible aggregate capacity; never plotted as facilities.

inputs.label: All utility-scale net summer capacity
inputs.reason: Matching national denominator from EIA Electric Power Annual.

limitations: Eligible utility-scale capacity is reproduced from EIA-860 generator rows; blank summer-capacity fields are not imputed.
Hydropower, geothermal, and biomass remain outside the eligible numerator pending site/pathway evidence.

denominator.definition: Total domestic utility-scale net generation plus estimated small-scale solar PV generation.

countryIndicators.importsTreatment: Imports and exports are outside this domestic production indicator.
limitations: Hydropower, geothermal, and biomass are excluded from the eligible numerator until site/pathway evidence satisfies V1 rules.
This is production-based domestic generation; imports are not included.
EIA values may not sum exactly because of independent rounding.

numerator.definition: Domestic net generation from V1-eligible nuclear, wind, and solar technologies.

countryIndicators.storageTreatment: Pumped-storage generation is excluded from primary generation and appears only in EIA's separate negative storage line.

denominator.definition: All utility-scale net summer capacity plus estimated small-scale solar PV capacity.

countryIndicators.importsTreatment: Capacity is domestic physical capacity; imports do not apply.
limitations: Eligible utility-scale capacity is reproduced from EIA-860 generator rows; blank summer-capacity fields are not imputed.
Hydropower, geothermal, and biomass remain outside the eligible numerator pending site/pathway evidence.

numerator.definition: Net summer capacity from V1-eligible utility-scale generators plus estimated small-scale solar PV.

countryIndicators.storageTreatment: Pumped hydro, batteries, and other storage are excluded from primary generating capacity.
